content.short: Mercato is the primary NFT aggregator on Aptos, providing unified liquidity and professional trading tools.
content.description:
Mercato is the definitive NFT marketplace aggregator built natively for the Aptos blockchain, designed to provide users with deep liquidity and the best possible prices across the ecosystem. By aggregating listings and bids from all major marketplaces—including Topaz, Bluemove, and Souffl3—Mercato offers a unified and efficient interface for trading digital assets. The platform features professional-grade tools such as real-time floor price tracking, advanced filtering, and instant sweep functionality for high-frequency collectors.

Leveraging the high throughput and low latency of the Aptos network, Mercato delivers a seamless and highly responsive user experience. The protocol is designed to support the growth of the Aptos NFT community by providing a transparent and interoperable venue for asset discovery and exchange. Through its commitment to user-centric design and technological innovation, Mercato has become a cornerstone of the Aptos creator economy, empowering artists and collectors with the tools needed for sophisticated on-chain trading.
